Admin/bridge-gated: setHub/setAddressOracle (CONFIG_CONTRACTS_ROLE), boostCapacity (BOOST_RATE_LIMIT_ROLE; eth_call from fresh addr 0x1111...1111 reverts 0xe2517d3f AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount), sendMessage (MESSAGE_SENDER_ROLE), addAdapter/removeAdapter (MANAGER_ROLE), receiveMessage (onlyRouter). The only truly permissionless entry points pay nothing: BridgeRouter.retryMessage/reverseMessage (external payable, retries a failed CCIP message at the caller's cost) and BridgeRouterSpoke.withdraw() (eth_call from a fresh address succeeds and pays balances[msg.sender], 0 for a stranger). Nothing on Polygon pays a caller: liquidations and rebalances live in the hub LoanManager on Avalanche (liquidate() pays the liquidator the collateral bonus; rebalanceUp/rebalanceDown are onlyRole(REBALANCER_ROLE)); rewards are claimed by their owner (SpokeRewardsV2 claimRewards / hub RewardLogic).
